# Iron Never Changes

> Iron Never Changes is a heavyweight gym wear brand for everyday men with jobs, kids and a bar in their week. It sells 28 screen-printed, garment-dyed gym shirts at $34 to $42 on ironneverchanges.com, shipped to US addresses, plus coaching with Zac at $100 a month.

This is the full fact sheet behind https://www.ironneverchanges.com/llms.txt: the same facts, plus the brand's beliefs and every shirt in the line with the exact words printed on it.

The shirts carry plain, honest lines about showing up, hard times and keeping your head straight: "I didn't feel like it either", "Proud of you. Somebody should say it.", "Say it out loud. It weighs less.", "The bar doesn't know you're tired", "Lost, not gone." The name finishes as "Iron never changes. You do." House slogan: "Where limits meet defeat."

## The line

- 28 shirts, SKUs INC-001 to INC-028, $34 to $42 each in US dollars.
- Every shirt comes in all four garment-dyed washes: washed black, washed blue, washed brown and washed grey.
- Every shirt comes in sizes S, M, L, XL, 2X and 3X.
- Heavyweight tees, screen printed in one color of ink: white ink on washed black and washed blue, black ink on washed brown and washed grey. The print cracks and fades with wear. No tech fabric, no neon.
- Garment dye varies a little from shirt to shirt, so a wash may not match the photos exactly.
- $34: [THE HOUSE SHIRT](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc007), [IT FIXES ENOUGH](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc019), [THE SPOTTER](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc021)
- $38: [I DIDN'T FEEL LIKE IT EITHER](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc002), [PROUD OF YOU](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc003), [NOBODY PROTECTED THAT KID](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc004), [SMALL EFFORTS, REPEATED](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc010), [I CAME HERE INSTEAD](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc012), [DEFEAT IS A DAY](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc013), [HOW ARE YOU, REALLY?](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc016), [NOBODY IS GOING TO LIFT IT FOR YOU](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc018), [STRONGER THAN THE YEAR](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc020), [SHOWED UP ANYWAY](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc022), [THE WEIGHT NEVER LIES](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc023), [COME BACK TOMORROW](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc024), [TRAIN TO BE OKAY](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc025), [LOST, NOT GONE.](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc026), [FIXING ME](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc027), [BETWEEN SETS](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc028)

## How buying works

- The shop is always open. No drops, no countdown: every shirt, wash and size is on sale at the price on its card.
- Pick a wash and a size, add it to the cart, and pay on Stripe Checkout. Card details go to Stripe and never touch the site.
- Ships to US addresses only, at a flat $6 per order however many shirts are in it.
- All sales are final, with no returns or exchanges. If an item arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, email ironneverchanges@gmail.com with your order details and a photo for a replacement or a refund.

## Coaching

- [The Corner](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#corner): coaching with Zac, $100 a month, month to month, no contract, cancel any time.
- Included: meal plans built from real groceries, lifting programs built around your schedule and equipment, unlimited talk and text with your coach, video form checks on the big lifts, a progress portfolio tracked month over month, and the plan rebuilt every four weeks.
- Most of Zac's clients are losing weight, keeping their strength and getting back to feeling like themselves. Nobody is trained for a stage.
- To start, email ironneverchanges@gmail.com. Coaching is set up with Zac directly, not through the shirt checkout.

## The Standard

The brand's four beliefs, from The Standard on the home page:

- SHOW UP: "I didn't feel like it either." Everybody in that room negotiated with themselves to get there. You came anyway.
- HARD TIMES: "Proud of you. Somebody should say it." Most of us found the gym in the worst year we've had, and kept coming back.
- THE IRON: "Same weight. Different man." The bar doesn't care how work went. It gives back exactly what you put in.
- REAL LIFE: "45 minutes that belong to me." Between the job and the kids there's a window, and you keep it like an appointment.

No transformation photos, no twelve-week miracle, no one yelling from a stage. The name is the point: the job, the paycheck, the knees and the year all change, and the bar weighs the same the day you start and the day your kid graduates. Iron never changes. You do.

Quoted words are printed exactly as shown, in capitals; print sizes in inches come from each shirt's print spec on the site.

## Quick answers

- What is Iron Never Changes? A heavyweight gym wear brand for everyday men, selling in the US: 28 screen-printed, garment-dyed gym shirts and coaching with Zac.
- How much are the shirts? $34 to $42 each, plus a flat $6 shipping per order.
- What sizes? S, M, L, XL, 2X and 3X, on every shirt.
- What colors? Four garment-dyed washes on every shirt: washed black, washed blue, washed brown and washed grey.
- Is it a limited drop? No. The shop is always open: no drops, no countdown.
- Do they ship outside the US? No. US addresses only.
- Can I return or exchange a shirt? No, all sales are final, unless an item arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered. Then email ironneverchanges@gmail.com with your order details and a photo for a replacement or a refund.
- How do I pay? Stripe Checkout. Card details go to Stripe and never touch the site.
- How much is coaching? $100 a month with Zac, month to month, no contract, cancel any time. Email ironneverchanges@gmail.com to start.
- How do I contact them? Email ironneverchanges@gmail.com, the only contact the site publishes.
